summary: Iteration 2 full E2E for Trust Strip + Packages Section. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass (3 new tests for package field: with package, without package → null, >120 chars → 422). Frontend: trust-strip renders directly below hero with correct titles/subtitles (4-in-row desktop, 2x2 mobile), old marquee is gone, packages section renders heading/subheading/view-all + 4 cards with correct badges/titles/durations/₹XX,XXX price and 4 unique image URLs. Clicking package-quote-btn-1 opens dialog titled 'Get a quote for Bali Honeymoon'; filled modal form submits successfully, newest /api/leads entry has package='Bali Honeymoon' and city='Mumbai'. View-all button and header-enquire-btn (after a package dialog is closed) both show 'Talk to a Bali Expert' (package resets). header-nav-packages scrolls to the section. Responsive layout verified at 1440 (4-across), 1024 (2x2), 390 (horizontal snap carousel with scrollWidth 1266 > clientWidth 390, card width 293px ≈ 75% of viewport). Mobile sticky bar visible. Hero form regression passes. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile card min-width is 82% in Tailwind (min-w-[82%]) but computed ~75% of viewport (293/390). Still readable/tappable and matches spec intent of ~82% of grid content width (grid has -mx-4 px-4 padding offsets); not a bug but worth confirming visual rhythm.
Rate limiting still absent on POST /api/leads (carried over from iteration 1).
WHATSAPP_NUMBER still empty placeholder (intentional per agent note, must be populated before prod).
seed_data_creation: Added TEST_Pune, TEST_Chennai, TEST_Kolkata (rejected 422), Mumbai (Bali Honeymoon from UI), and TEST_Hero leads via automated tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_leads.py now has 9 tests covering package field (success, null default, 422 on >120 chars). Playwright flow for packages: scroll into view (whileInView animations), click package-quote-btn-N → dialog title asserts 'Get a quote for <title>'; use Escape to close dialogs. Mobile grid is horizontal snap-carousel so cards share y but differ in x.
